All four were updated for the approved 32K response / 900-second GM invocation settings and passed in the final focused suite.

verified: SQLite descriptor exhaustion reproduced in legacy polling; 2000 fixed polls with GC disabled remain bounded
Monitor startup, death, telemetry writes and failed notification cannot abort training
Independent deadline stops dummy owned work and produces terminal status and cleanup receipts
Final owner snapshot preserves monitor timing observations and avoids duplicate metric emission
Offline report reconciles stale running metadata and displays stopped queued/running operations as interrupted without changing their durable journal status
API inactivity covers missing headers, first stream bytes and midstream stalls
Keepalives reset inactivity; time between API exchanges does not consume it
Native Codex startup and session resume work with fresh relays
Synthetic command-backed credentials and account headers reach the mock upstream without appearing in relay audit
Cancellation closes relay sockets and owned Codex process groups
GM defaults and the micro recipe use medium effort, 900-second invocation and 180-second API idle limits; Player response allowance is 32768 tokens
limits: No real authenticated provider call, full-context capacity test or training qualification was performed for this PR.
Optional runtime-dependent tests skipped in the broad run remain skipped; they are not reported as passed.
